Code, not assets. Radar and HUD pages under src/game/client/library/swgClientUserInterface/src/shared/page.

inspiration: Ground radar with role-coded blips: one routine draws each nearby object with a shape chosen by role (target bracket, difficulty ring, group marker, waypoint arrow, corpse marker) (SwgCuiGroundRadar_BlipPane.cpp lines 329, 588, 600, 612). Idea: radar as the main readability tool at 375 wide.
Radar range from a data table, not hard-coded (SwgCuiGroundRadar.cpp line 95). Idea: radar range as zone data on one runtime.

Effect authoring as separate tools: particles, swoosh trails, lightning arcs, client effects and sound each have an editor (src/engine/client/application/ParticleEditor, SwooshEditor, LightningEditor, ClientEffectEditor, SoundEditor). Idea: each effect family gets its own small parameter set so trails and hit flashes can be tuned without code.
Animation and skeletal manifests as indexed catalogues (data_animation_00 and data_skeletal_mesh_00 line counts). Idea: animation clips as a catalogue for row 7 creature clips.

briefs.label: Role-coded radar blips (own label)
briefs.why: At 375 wide, a radar that shows target, threat and waypoint by shape reads at a glance.
briefs.keep: One blip language per role; a waypoint arrow.
briefs.change: Our own glyph shapes and colour logic; a corpse marker that fades; no copy of the donor's blip art. Sound: none in donor, ours to design. Recreate as a distinct original, not a copy.

briefs.label: Weapon trail authored in a tool (own label)
briefs.why: A swoosh trail artists can tune in a dedicated editor keeps weapon feel adjustable without code.
briefs.keep: A separate authoring tool for trails.
briefs.change: Our own trail shape and fade, tied to our hitstop. Recreate as a distinct original, not a copy.

briefs.label: Lightning arc effect (own label)
briefs.why: An arc that jumps between two points reads as magic at a glance.
briefs.change: Our own jitter and colour, shown only on the caster's target. Recreate as a distinct original, not a copy.
